prTitle: Improve time complexity and reduce memory allocations

content.motivation: The code change aims to optimize the process of resolving tool definitions by pre-collecting tool names from existing `ToolCallback` objects into a `Set`. This avoids repeated stream operations within the loop, leading to better performance when checking if a tool name is already present.
goodPoints: The introduction of `existingToolNames` as a `Set` significantly improves the efficiency of checking for existing tool callbacks.
The code now uses a more concise and readable stream operation to collect the existing tool names.
The overall logic for resolving tool definitions remains correct and handles the case where a tool might be specified both as a callback and a tool name.
badPoints: The PMD static analysis report flags several issues that are not addressed by this change. These include field naming conventions for `logger`, `GuardLogStatement` for logger calls, and modifier order in the `Builder` class.
content.suggestion: Address the outstanding PMD violations: rename the `logger` field to `LOGGER`, wrap log statements with appropriate log level guards, and correct the modifier order in the `Builder` class.

details: Introduced a `Set<String> existingToolNames` to store the names of tools already present in `chatOptions.getToolCallbacks()`.
Replaced the `anyMatch` stream operation inside the loop with a `contains` check on the `existingToolNames` set for improved performance.

issues.title: Field Naming Conventions Violation
issues.detail: The constant name 'logger' doesn't match '[A-Z][A-Z_0-9]*'. Constants should be in uppercase.

issues.title: Guard Log Statement Violation
issues.detail: Logger calls should be surrounded by log level guards (e.g., `if (logger.isDebugEnabled()) { ... }`).

issues.title: Modifier Order Violation
issues.detail: Missorted modifiers `final static`. The correct order is `static final`.
